issues.problem: HardcoreAluminium, HardcoreOsmium and EnableInjectorRecipeOfInterface are SERVER config values, but ConfigEnabledCondition reads them while datapacks load. On world start, NeoForge loads world datapacks before the SERVER config, so `value()` catches IllegalStateException and silently returns the default. The switches only take effect after `/reload`. `optionalRecipeSwitchesDriveConditions` only tests the reload path.
issues.reason: AC-F049-004 requires the preserved settings to work. A user who sets HardcoreAluminium=true sees no change on server start, and the try/catch fallback hides the load-order problem.
issues.fix: Move the recipe-switch options (and ProgressionRate if it must apply to recipe loading) to the COMMON (startup) spec so they are loaded before datapacks. Remove the IllegalStateException fallback in `value()`, and add a test that confirms the condition state on the initial load.

issues.problem: The config code has dead or duplicated parts. MIN_TIER, MAX_TIER and checkTier are duplicated in TierManager. The trivial `define` factories and the NaN-filled `overrides` array hack add indirection. TransportBalance defines `_def` keys and null fallbacks that are never reached, because every tier is defined. The `value()` try/catch is a fallback.
